# E2E Smoke Test — validates CI-built provider binary via terraform plan
#
# This workflow validates the provider binary end-to-end by:
# 1. Downloading the CI-built provider binary
# 2. Configuring a dev override so Terraform uses it instead of the registry version
# 3. Running terraform init + plan against test-projects/v1-tf-generic-test/
#
# This verifies that the compiled binary can load, parse HCL, resolve data
# sources (connector registry lookups), and produce a valid execution plan.
#
# For full E2E testing (apply, drift check, destroy), use the Devin E2E
# testing skill defined in .agents/skills/e2e-testing/SKILL.md.
#
# Triggers:
# - workflow_call: invoked by test-full.yml after provider binaries are built
# - workflow_dispatch: for manual runs (requires run-id of a workflow that produced provider_binaries)
#
# Note: run-id is always required. For workflow_call, the caller must pass github.run_id.

name: E2E Smoke Test

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      run-id:
        description: 'Workflow run ID to download provider_binaries artifact from'
        type: string
        required: true
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run-id:
        description: 'Workflow run ID to download provider_binaries artifact from'
        type: string
        required: true

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

jobs:
  e2e-smoke-test:
    name: E2E Smoke Test (v1-tf-generic-test)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: test-projects/v1-tf-generic-test
    env:
      # Plan-only: credentials are needed for data source resolution
      # (connector registry lookups) but not for resource creation.
      TF_VAR_airbyte_client_id: ${{ secrets.AIRBYTE_CLIENT_ID }}
      TF_VAR_airbyte_client_secret: ${{ secrets.AIRBYTE_CLIENT_SECRET }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Terraform
        uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3
        with:
          terraform_wrapper: false

      - name: Download provider binary artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: provider_binaries
          path: /tmp/provider-bin
          run-id: ${{ inputs.run-id }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Configure provider dev override
        run: |
          mkdir -p provider-override
          cp /tmp/provider-bin/terraform-provider-airbyte_linux_amd64 provider-override/terraform-provider-airbyte
          chmod +x provider-override/terraform-provider-airbyte

          OVERRIDE_DIR="$(pwd)/provider-override"
          cat > "$HOME/.terraformrc" <<EOF
          provider_installation {
            dev_overrides {
              "airbytehq/airbyte" = "${OVERRIDE_DIR}"
            }
            direct {}
          }
          EOF

          echo "Provider binary:"
          ls -lh provider-override/terraform-provider-airbyte
          echo "Terraform RC:"
          cat "$HOME/.terraformrc"

      # Note: 'terraform init' is skipped when using dev_overrides — Terraform
      # prints a warning and proceeds without downloading the provider. We still
      # run it to initialise the working directory and any backend configuration.
      - name: Terraform Init
        run: terraform init

      - name: Terraform Plan
        run: |
          set +eo pipefail
          terraform plan 2>&1 | tee plan_output.txt
          PLAN_EXIT_CODE=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
          set -eo pipefail

          if [ "$PLAN_EXIT_CODE" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "Terraform plan failed with exit code $PLAN_EXIT_CODE"
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Plan succeeded — CI-built binary is valid."

# Validate Speakeasy Generation (Dry Run) + Zero-Diff Check
#
# This workflow validates that Speakeasy generation can complete successfully
# and that the committed generated code matches what the generation pipeline produces.
#
# Jobs:
# 1. validate: Runs the full generation pipeline in dry-run mode (build + compile check)
# 2. zero-diff: Compares the dry-run artifacts against the committed code to detect drift.
#    If drift is detected, the check fails and posts a comment telling the author to run /generate.
# 3. e2e-smoke-test: Validates the CI-built provider binary by running terraform plan
#    against test-projects/v1-tf-generic-test/ (plan-only, no apply/destroy).
#
# This workflow calls the main generation workflow with dry_run=true to ensure
# both workflows use the same generation logic.
#
# Note: paths-ignore is NOT used at the workflow level because GitHub treats a
# workflow that never runs as "expected" (pending), which blocks required checks.
# Instead, we filter paths at the job level so skipped jobs report as "skipped"
# (equivalent to "passed" for required checks).

name: Test (Full)

on:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  actions: read

jobs:
  check-paths:
    name: Check Changed Paths
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Filter changed paths
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v4
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            generation:
              - '**'
              - '!README.md'
              - '!docs/**'
              - '!examples/**'
    outputs:
      should_run: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || steps.filter.outputs.generation == 'true' }}

  validate:
    name: Validate Generation (Dry Run)
    needs: check-paths
    if: needs.check-paths.outputs.should_run == 'true'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/generate-command.yml
    with:
      dry_run: true
    secrets: inherit

  zero-diff:
    name: Zero-Diff Check (Generated Code)
    needs: [check-paths, validate]
    if: needs.check-paths.outputs.should_run == 'true' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout PR branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download generated provider code artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: generated_provider_code
          path: /tmp/generated/

      - name: Download generated docs artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: generated_docs
          path: /tmp/generated-docs/

      - name: Compare generated code against committed code
        id: diff-check
        run: |
          DIFF_OUTPUT=""

          echo "=== Comparing generated provider code ==="
          # upload-artifact strips paths to the least common ancestor (internal/),
          # so artifacts are at /tmp/generated/provider/ and /tmp/generated/sdk/
          PROVIDER_DIFF=$(diff -rq internal/provider/ /tmp/generated/provider/ 2>&1 || true)
          if [ -n "$PROVIDER_DIFF" ]; then
              DIFF_OUTPUT="${DIFF_OUTPUT}${PROVIDER_DIFF}"$'\n'
          fi

          # Exclude .gitattributes and .gitignore — these are static repo files, not generated
          SDK_DIFF=$(diff -rq --exclude='.gitattributes' --exclude='.gitignore' internal/sdk/ /tmp/generated/sdk/ 2>&1 || true)
          if [ -n "$SDK_DIFF" ]; then
              DIFF_OUTPUT="${DIFF_OUTPUT}${SDK_DIFF}"$'\n'
          fi

          echo "=== Comparing generated docs ==="
          DOCS_DIFF=$(diff -rq docs/ /tmp/generated-docs/ 2>&1 || true)
          if [ -n "$DOCS_DIFF" ]; then
              DIFF_OUTPUT="${DIFF_OUTPUT}${DOCS_DIFF}"$'\n'
          fi

          if [ -n "$DIFF_OUTPUT" ]; then
              echo "has_diff=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              echo "::warning::Generated code drift detected. The committed code does not match what the generation pipeline produces."
              echo "$DIFF_OUTPUT" | head -50
              echo "$DIFF_OUTPUT" | head -20 > /tmp/diff_summary.txt
          else
              echo "has_diff=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              echo "Zero-diff check passed. Committed code matches generation output."
          fi

      - name: Prepare diff summary
        if: steps.diff-check.outputs.has_diff == 'true'
        id: diff-summary
        run: |
          SUMMARY=$(cat /tmp/diff_summary.txt 2>/dev/null || echo "(see job logs for full details)")
          # Escape for GitHub Actions output (multiline)
          EOF=$(dd if=/dev/urandom bs=15 count=1 status=none | base64)
          echo "content<<$EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "$SUMMARY" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "$EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Find existing drift comment
        if: steps.diff-check.outputs.has_diff == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/find-comment@v3
        id: find-drift-comment
        with:
          issue-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          body-includes: '<!-- zero-diff-check -->'

      - name: Post drift comment on PR
        if: steps.diff-check.outputs.has_diff == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@v5
        with:
          issue-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          comment-id: ${{ steps.find-drift-comment.outputs.comment-id || '' }}
          edit-mode: replace
          body: |
            <!-- zero-diff-check -->
            **Generated Code Drift Detected**

            The committed code does not match what the generation pipeline produces. This usually means a generated file was edited by hand or the generation pipeline needs to be re-run.

            **To fix:** Comment `/generate` on this PR to regenerate and push updated code.

            **To debug locally:** Download the generated artifacts and diff them against your committed code:
            ```bash
            gh run download ${{ github.run_id }} --name generated_provider_code --dir /tmp/generated_from_ci
            diff -rq internal/provider/ /tmp/generated_from_ci/provider/
            diff -rq --exclude=.gitattributes --exclude=.gitignore internal/sdk/ /tmp/generated_from_ci/sdk/
            ```
            See [CONTRIBUTING.md — Debugging Generation Drift Failures](https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#debugging-generation-drift-failures) for the full procedure.

            <details>
            <summary>Diff summary</summary>

            ```
            ${{ steps.diff-summary.outputs.content }}
            ```

            </details>

      - name: Fail if drift detected
        if: steps.diff-check.outputs.has_diff == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "::error::Generated code drift detected. Run /generate on this PR to fix, or debug locally with: gh run download ${{ github.run_id }} --name generated_provider_code --dir /tmp/generated_from_ci && diff -rq internal/provider/ /tmp/generated_from_ci/provider/ && diff -rq --exclude=.gitattributes --exclude=.gitignore internal/sdk/ /tmp/generated_from_ci/sdk/ . See CONTRIBUTING.md#debugging-generation-drift-failures for the full procedure."
          exit 1

  e2e-smoke-test:
    name: E2E Smoke Test
    needs: [check-paths, validate]
    if: needs.check-paths.outputs.should_run == 'true' && (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork == false)
    uses: ./.github/workflows/e2e-smoke-test.yml
    with:
      run-id: ${{ github.run_id }}
    secrets: inherit

# Terraform Provider Testing Workflow
#
# This workflow runs build, lint, and acceptance tests for the Terraform provider.
# It runs automatically on every pull request.
#
# Jobs:
# - build: Compiles the provider and runs golangci-lint
# - verify-docs-drift: Checks that generated docs (from `go generate`) are up to date
# - test: Runs Terraform acceptance tests against multiple Terraform versions
#
# Note: This workflow does NOT run Speakeasy generation. For Speakeasy regeneration
# of the provider code, use the manual "Generate" workflow (generate-command.yml).
#
# Note: Acceptance tests require TF_ACC=1 and may need additional credentials
# for testing against a real Airbyte instance.

name: Test (No Generate)

# This GitHub action runs your tests for each pull request.
on:
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - 'README.md'

# Testing only needs permissions to read the repository contents.
permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  # Ensure project builds before running testing matrix
  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@8f4b7f84864484a7bf31766abe9204da3cbe65b3 # v3.5.0
      - uses: actions/setup-go@4d34df0c2316fe8122ab82dc22947d607c0c91f9 # v4.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'
          cache: true
      - run: go mod download
      - run: go build -v .
      - name: Run linters
        uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@1e7e51e771db61008b38414a730f564565cf7c20 # v9.2.0
        with:
          version: latest

  verify-docs-drift:
    name: Verify Docs Are Up-to-Date
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@8f4b7f84864484a7bf31766abe9204da3cbe65b3 # v3.5.0
      - uses: actions/setup-go@4d34df0c2316fe8122ab82dc22947d607c0c91f9 # v4.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'
          cache: true
      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v5
      - name: Regenerate docs
        run: uvx --from=poethepoet poe docs-generate
      - name: Check for docs drift
        id: docs_drift
        run: |
          git diff --compact-summary --exit-code || \
            (echo; echo "Generated files are out of date. Run 'uvx --from=poethepoet poe docs-generate' and commit the result."; exit 1)
      - name: Create diff artifact
        if: failure() && steps.docs_drift.outcome == 'failure'
        run: |
          git diff > generated-docs-diff.patch
          echo "Generated docs diff saved to generated-docs-diff.patch"
      - name: Upload diff artifact
        if: failure() && steps.docs_drift.outcome == 'failure'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: generated-docs-diff
          path: generated-docs-diff.patch
          retention-days: 7

  # Run acceptance tests in a matrix with Terraform CLI versions
  test:
    name: Terraform Provider Acceptance Tests
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        # list whatever Terraform versions here you would like to support
        terraform:
          - '1.0.*'
          - '1.1.*'
          - '1.2.*'
          - '1.3.*'
          - '1.4.*'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@8f4b7f84864484a7bf31766abe9204da3cbe65b3 # v3.5.0
      - uses: actions/setup-go@4d34df0c2316fe8122ab82dc22947d607c0c91f9 # v4.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'
          cache: true
      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@633666f66e0061ca3b725c73b2ec20cd13a8fdd1 # v2.0.3
        with:
          terraform_version: ${{ matrix.terraform }}
          terraform_wrapper: false
      - run: go mod download
      - env:
          TF_ACC: "1"
        run: go test -v -cover ./internal/provider/
        timeout-minutes: 10
